descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The core mechanics are based on memory and survival. The player does not carry a map with them at all times; instead, they must view the map at specific locations, memorize the route, and navigate through a dark environment (using a flashlight) while fleeing from zombies to find the exit.

**Zero Risk**, Not sure if it's for you? Get a **15-minute free trial** 



[media]

Worried You Might Regret Your Purchase?

No worries! If you change your mind, Meta may offer a refund according to its refund policy.

Play with confidence and enjoy the game — you can buy without the stress!
